commitment is a multidimensional construct that can be conceptualized and measured in terms of the degree to which an individual has a) compliance with organizational norms, b) identifies with the organization and its goals, c) internalizes those goals as personal values.

the more an individual internalizes the values and norms of an organization, and the more that individual identifies with the organization and its members, the more likely that individual will engage in prosocial behaviors.
